instruction.name: vreplgr2vr.b
instruction.description: Broadcast the low 8 bits of `val` to all lanes of `dst`.

latencies.notes: 3 cycles for this direction. The two directions cannot be separated by chaining, so the split follows the microarchitecture: an FPR or vector load cannot bypass, and the vector float reset helper measures pick + 2 + repl = 7 for LSX and 9 for LASX, which fixes the pick at 3 and 5. The stored experiment is the round trip.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr1, $r5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr4, $r8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr5, $r9; vreplgr2vr.b $vr6, $r10; vreplgr2vr.b $vr7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.b $vr1, $r5; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r6; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r7; vreplgr2vr.b $vr4, $r8; vreplgr2vr.b $vr5, $r9; vreplgr2vr.b $vr6, $r10; vreplgr2vr.b $vr7, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.00 cycles. Counter 0xfb is normalised per instruction.

notes: LSX two-uop instruction. Individual latency is not separable without a round trip through the reverse move; throughput is measured with 8 independent lanes. Extra counter 0xfb records the classified uop count.
